context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 標本/返却/動き出し/没頭/書斎/切り捨て/開講/社名

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、製品の標本、学習材料として活用しろ。
lines.en: Ren, use these product samples as learning material.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Lean forward slightly with the name—establishing focus. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone opening a door, not commanding. Weight on 'use', easy trailing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。借りた資料は、必ず返却します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to return any materials I borrow.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Slight nod on 'yes'—eager to prove reliability. Even pace, careful articulation. The voice of someone who wants to be trusted, not just obedient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、デジタル化が動き出した。
lines.en: The industry is moving into digitalization now.
lines.style: Forward-looking, observational. Quiet authority—not lecturing, informing. Slight pause before 'digitalization' like placing a marker on a map. Calm, steady pace. The tone of someone watching change unfold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究に没頭できる環境、ありがたいです。
lines.en: I'm grateful to have an environment where I can really throw myself into research.
lines.style: Warm sincerity underneath the formality. Breath-catch of genuine appreciation in the opening. Slower pace on 'absorbed' — savoring the acknowledgment. Not performative, but honest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 専務の書斎、君も招いてもらえる日が来る。
lines.en: The day will come when you're invited to the senior executive's study.
lines.style: Assured and measured. Soft weight on 'will come'—not a promise, an observation. Slight lean-in, like sharing quiet confidence. Warm but not sentimental. The tone of someone who sees a future already.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 若手を切り捨てる組織、避けたいですね。
lines.en: I'd rather not end up at an organization that discards young talent.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tense underneath. Careful word choice—he's thinking as he speaks. Steady pace but a faint firmness on 'discards'. Not aggressive, but the conviction of someone who's thought about what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来月、社内講座、開講する。社名のブランド、君も学べ。
lines.en: We're opening an in-house course next month. You should learn the company brand alongside everything else.
lines.style: Warm directive. The 'we' carries inclusion. Slight shift to softer tone on 'brand'—a signal of deeper value. Steady pace, but ease on the trailing—inviting him into something bigger than instruction.
